user_message: Why can energy be released both by fusing light nuclei and by splitting very heavy nuclei?
allowed_evidence: Binding energy per nucleon generally rises from very light nuclei toward the iron-nickel region and then slowly falls for heavier nuclei. A reaction can release energy when its products have lower total mass, corresponding to greater total binding.
public_rubric: Uses one consistent energetic principle for fusion and fission.
Connects the explanation to total nuclear binding rather than slogans.
States that favorable energy balance alone does not determine whether a reaction proceeds rapidly.
